title: Outlaw Posse
description:
S1 E1
DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

title: Gang In Blue
description:
S1 E1
A group of white police officers allow their racist feelings to turn murderous.

title: Juice
description:
S1 E1
Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

title: Out Of Sync
description:
S1 E1
After he is released from prison, a former DJ tries to go straight and put his various vices behind him.

title: Barbershop
description:
S1 E1
Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy .

title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
description:
S1 E1 — Barbershop 2: Back in Business (2004)
The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
description:
S1 E1
Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.
